newsitem.title: CHILE: Codelco sees copper $0.80-0.90 in '97 - official.
newsitem.headline: Codelco sees copper $0.80-0.90 in '97 - official.

text.p: The average copper price should not fall below $0.80 a pound in 1997 or in 1998, a top Codelco futures trading official said Thursday.

"We think that copper is not going to go too low really next year. We think an average 80, 85, 88 even 90 cents for next year could be reasonable," Jorge Cristi, general manager of Codelco's futures market department, told Reuters in an interview at a copper conference.
He said prices in 1998 should be from $0.80-0.85.

"We think that the situation is changing, (mining) projects are not running on time...and we think that next year 80, 88, 90 cents could be the average price. We don't believe that the price will crash or go down," he said.
"We are very optimistic about the market, because the Chinese produce a lot of copper and they will close some mines because they are making losses," Cristi explained.
